Create a label object

Set a new text for a label. Memory will be allocated to store the text by the label.
obj
pointer to a label object
text
'\0' terminated character string. NULL to refresh with the current text.

Set a static text. It will not be saved by the label so the 'text' variable has to be 'alive' while the label exists.
obj
pointer to a label object
text
pointer to a text. NULL to refresh with the current text.

obj
pointer to a label object
long_mode
the new mode from 'lv_label_long_mode' enum. In LV_LONG_WRAP/DOT/SCROLL/SCROLL_CIRC the size of the label should be set AFTER this function

index
index of the character [0 ... text length - 1]. Expressed in character index, not byte index (different in UTF-8)

detaileddescription.para:
Insert a text to a label. The label text can not be static.
obj
pointer to a label object
pos
character index to insert. Expressed in character index and not byte index. 0: before first char. LV_LABEL_POS_LAST: after last char.
txt
pointer to the text to insert

Delete characters from a label. The label text can not be static.
obj
pointer to a label object
pos
character index from where to cut. Expressed in character index and not byte index. 0: start in from of the first character
cnt
number of characters to cut
